name: Japan (MHLW/PMDA)

changes.notes: Nine more quiz questions in the shared module (every lesson now has at least eight). No rule changes. Source links checked on 2026-10-17: moved pages updated and secondary sources replaced with official ones where they exist.

about: The package insert of a prescription drug in the format in use since April 2019 (PSEHB Notification No. 0608-1, 2017): header items, then numbered sections 1 to 26 whose numbers are kept even when a section is empty. Since August 2021 the insert is electronic, reached from a code on the outer box. The practice text is an English rendering; Japanese inserts are in Japanese.

watch.title: Structured electronic package inserts (ePI-JP)
watch.text: A FHIR implementation guide for Japanese electronic package inserts is in development. The app shows the section structure only.

sources.title: Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Safety Information No. 344 (June 2017, MHLW, English by PMDA): the revised package insert format under PSEHB Notification No. 0608-1
Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Safety Information No. 360 (February 2019): package inserts under the revised instructions
PMDA: electronic package inserts (paper inserts abolished in principle from August 2021; code on the outer box)
HL7 Japanese Electronic Medicinal Product Information (ePI-JP) FHIR implementation guide, continuous build (draft)
